dms.title: Dead Man's Switch
dms.subtitle: If you stop checking in, your vaults are handed over to your Executor.
dms.notSetUpHint: Choose your schedule on the right and save to turn it on.
dms.triggeredNote: The hand-over was triggered on {{date}}. Settings can no longer be changed.
dms.suspendedNote: Suspended by an administrator. Please contact support.

checkinIntervalDays.label: Check-in every (days)
checkinIntervalDays.hint: How often you need to confirm you are okay.

gracePeriodDays.label: Grace period (days)
gracePeriodDays.hint: Extra time after a missed check-in before hand-over starts.

reminderCount.label: Reminders
reminderCount.hint: Emails sent during the grace period.

dms.checkedIn: Checked in. We'll remind you before the next deadline.

executors.title: Executors
executors.subtitle: Trusted people who handle the hand-over. They must have a verified LegacyVault account.

PRIMARY.title: Primary Executor
PRIMARY.text: Notified first when your Dead Man's Switch triggers.

BACKUP.title: Backup Executor
BACKUP.text: Takes over if the primary does not respond within 14 days.

executors.revokeMessage: {{email}} will no longer be able to handle your hand-over.
